title: Step Counter
prompt: Create a class Counter with a method tick() that returns the number of ticks so far (1 on the first call). Use an instance attribute, not a global.

tests.name: ticks increment
tests.hint: Store the count in __init__ and increment in tick.

tests.name: independent counters
tests.code:
a, b = Counter(), Counter()
a.tick(); a.tick()
assert b.tick() == 1
assert 'count' not in Counter.__dict__, 'count must be instance state set in __init__, not a class attribute'
tests.hint: Each instance owns its own state.
